messages:
sam_dev: FYI seeing duplicate uploads when Activity rotates during a long Retrofit call in the sample app. Repro on Android 15 emulator and a Pixel 4a. Looks like the previous Call isn't cancelled on coroutine/job cancellation so the new Activity instance starts the same request again.

natalie_sdk: Ugh. Are you using enqueue() or a suspend adapter? Rotation should cancel the job and underlying Call.cancel() must be invoked.

sam_dev: Helper code we have (simplified):
```kotlin
fun startUpload(body: RequestBody) {
  val call = service.upload(body)
  call.enqueue(object: Callback { ... }) // fire-and-forget
}
```
When ViewModel is cleared we cancel the coroutine scope but enqueue doesn't auto-cancel the okhttp Call. Two calls race and server sees duplicates.

ravi_mobile: Common pitfall. Wrap the Call in a suspend extension that cancels the Call on coroutine cancel. Example pattern:
```kotlin
suspend fun Call.awaitResponse(): Response = suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
  cont.invokeOnCancellation { cancel() }
  enqueue(object: Callback { ... cont.resume(response) })
}
```
That ties lifecycle correctly.

natalie_sdk: Also ensure the OkHttpClient is a singleton shared across Activities. If you create a new client per Activity you lose connection reuse and may see extra races under rotation.

sam_dev: Tried the await wrapper + invokeOnCancellation and it fixed duplicates locally. But curious: any recommended defaults for mobile timeouts / dispatcher when using lots of short uploads?

tom_infra: For mobile uploads we usually set: Dispatcher(maxRequests=6, maxRequestsPerHost=3), connectTimeout=10s, readTimeout=20s, callTimeout=120s. Also keep a single ConnectionPool per app and consider short keepAlive for emulators.

ravi_mobile: One more tip: mark non-idempotent requests with header and gate automatic retry logic, or implement idempotency keys server-side to make duplicate safe.

sam_dev: Pushed a tiny sample and fix under android/samples/rotation-upload-dup. CI queued. ci-bot: CI: samples/rotation-upload-dup build queued (job #11022).
